소유자 제공
Located in Mangwon-dong, we serve delicious Japanese-style Western cuisine, including omurice, tonkatsu, taco rice, pollack roe yakisoba, and Napolitan pasta. Our space welcomes everyone from solo diners to groups of up to 6, and we are proudly pet-friendly! We are just an 8-minute walk from Mangwon Station. Online and offline waiting is available via Catch Table, so please feel free to visit and enjoy your time with us.
